attractions.name: Koh Larn (Coral Island)
attractions.description: Island with clear shallow waters, soft coral sand and coconut palms. Activities include parasailing, banana boat rides, jet skiing, snorkeling and glass-bottom kayaking.
attractions.hours: Best time to visit: 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
tips: Tawaen Beach is lively and activity-filled
Samae Beach is quieter and scenic
